DUSK is a psychological horror film that blends suspense and supernatural elements, exploring the idea that some darkness doesn’t end—it returns. Starring Laura Bailey (Critical Role), alongside Bruce DuBose and Todd Haberkorn, the film delivers a character-driven descent into fear, where survival means recognizing what’s been hunting you all along.
7181.trailerName: DUSK Trailer — starring Laura Bailey (Critical Role)

1440397.trailerName: Providence and the Guitar - Trailer | IFFR 2026

1490253.title: The Red Barn

Keeping in mind the symbolically charged image of the red barn in the painting, it deliberately incites arguments between the actors, the director and the crew about the motivations of the characters as well as alternative actions or decisions that they could have taken but did not.

1528845.title: Kyoto Hippocrates

After saving the life of a rough young man, Shinzaburō, through surgery, the man turned his life around and began training to become a doctor himself. Fifteen years later, having studied the latest medical science in Nagasaki, Shinzaburō returns and joins Taikichi in confronting a suspected outbreak of typhoid fever. Set against the backdrop of a time when Kampo and Western medicine competed for legitimacy, this moving historical drama follows the struggles of doctors who risked everything to save lives during Japan’s medical awakening.

1534221.title: A Long Winter
1534221.overview: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

1536845.title: Monument

1548749.title: Still Hope

Hope finally finds freedom and reunites with the family that never gave up looking for her. Though now safe, she struggles adjusting to her old life as she reconciles with all she’s endured. 1571981.title: Jellyfish, The new Rulers of the Ocean
1571981.overview: Jellyfish blooms are making headlines around the world. This is due to the damage they cause to tourism, fishing and our health. How can these creatures, which are over 98% water and have no shell, skeleton or brain, expand so rapidly?  Although this is a normal stage in the life cycle of these gelatinous animals, we have to admit that blooms have become much more frequent and massive in recent decades. We're even witnessing jellyfish populations appearing in more and more regions where fish have been replaced by them, such as off the coast of Namibia, in the Black Sea, in the Sea of Japan and in certain areas of the Baltic Sea. What causes this? Why has the role of jellyfish in the ocean been underestimated, even though they outlived the dinosaurs? Are jellyfish on their way to dominating the oceans as they once did? What if they were to be the only ones left?
1571981.trailerName: Jellyfish, the new rulers of the ocean - Trailer

1617805.title: Prompt: Make a Documentary
1617805.overview: Prompt: Make a Documentary investigates the growing influence of artificial intelligence on the film industry.  The documentary places the rise of AI within the broader historical context of cinema’s evolution, drawing parallels with earlier technological shifts such as the introduction of sound, colour, and digital visual effects. By revisiting landmark moments in film history, the film demonstrates that disruption has always been part of cinema’s DNA, while questioning whether AI represents a fundamentally different kind of change.  Featuring insights from directors, academics, and practitioners, Prompt: Make a Documentary explores the tension between innovation and integrity, the democratisation of creative tools, and the ethical implications of automation in the arts. The film ultimately asks whether artificial intelligence will empower the next generation of storytellers or redefine creativity itself.

1713421.overview: A short film based on the novel the stranger in a silent film style.

1713485.title: For Peace of Mind
1713485.overview: In a world shaped before her time, Kya is learning softer, slower, freer ways to exist. When her mother, Gigi, unexpectedly arrives, she brings with her the generational discord Kya has been quietly working through. Rather than resist her mother’s presence, Kya learns to move with it. She seeks refuge in healing rituals with a circle of women she trusts, guided by a powerful healer named Martha, whose ancient medicine, Rapé, loosens something long buried in Kya and begins to soothe her generational wound. Through tears and sacred smoke and the roar of the ocean, her journey is revealed. And she finds the courage to hold her mother’s story, her grandmother’s story and her great-grandmother’s story with tenderness.

1713997.title: EROS
1713997.overview: Beatriz is trapped in a vicious cycle where she doesn’t feel seen. All of that changes once she meets Sofia.

1714893.title: Ace and Cody vs. The Fry
1714893.overview: In the spirit of Scott Pilgrim vs. the World, Ace and Cody vs. The Fry is a high-energy, hyper-stylized short film that turns the most trivial moment—the last fry in the bucket—into the most important battle of two best friends’ lives. The second that lone fry is spotted, Ace makes the first move, setting off a breathless chase through a sprawling park that transforms the fields into a full-blown war zone. As the pursuit escalates like a video game fight, Ace and Cody are pushed to increasingly ridiculous heights in a showdown where everything seems to hinge on a single french fry.

1716365.title: Ryan Hamilton: This Just Hit Me
1716365.overview: Leave it to Ryan Hamilton to get hit by a bus and have the last laugh — whether it's falling for his anesthesiologist or a dispensary trip with his mom.

1716877.title: Back To Black
1716877.overview: A young woman, unable to move on from a failed relationship, spirals into depression, drugs, and alcohol.  Haunted by memories of the man she once loved, she struggles to escape the past that continues to consume her.  Desperate for answers, she seeks him out, only to uncover a devastating truth he has been hiding from her all along.  But once she learns the truth, she makes a choice that can never be undone

1717197.title: Messi: The Forgotten Tape

1717645.title: Imichki

1717773.title: Yet Again Another Great Chase
1717773.overview: The Chase Continues, but is this it?

1719117.title: Luminesence

1719629.title: À la nage!

1720461.overview: A young boy's world begins to turn upside down when he is neglected by all those around him & can only find comfort when a mysterious red basketball arrives on his doorstep.

1723405.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 13
1723405.overview: The thirteenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 8, 2026, at Yokohama Budokan in Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between OSKAR and Callum Newman.

1724813.title: The Last Footage
1724813.overview: When a young boy disappears during a getaway to a remote forest cabin, a desperate blood ritual resurrects a witch’s dead son while a reckless dark web summoning awakens an ancient predator lurking in the wilderness. Trapped between two awakened horrors, a group of friends fight to survive as their final moments are captured through a single pair of camera glasses.  Myanmar’s first found-footage horror film.

1724941.title: The Day Diego Returned to the Azteca
1724941.overview: The Day Diego Returned to the Azteca, a new ESPN Films documentary revisiting Diego Armando Maradona’s only return to Estadio Azteca in 2000, 14 years after leading Argentina to its historic World Cup win, is now streaming on Disney+ in the U.S. and in select international markets. It will make its linear debut July 3 at 10 p.m. ET on ESPN2 and ESPN Deportes.  The film tells the extraordinary and little-known story of Diego Armando Maradona’s only return to Estadio Azteca after leading Argentina to the 1986 FIFA World Cup title. Maradona returned to the stadium in 2000 while traveling from Cuba to Mexico for Boca Juniors’ Copa Libertadores semifinal against Club América.

1729677.title: Armony
1729677.overview: Armony, a 55-year-old solitary truck driver, finds himself taking responsibility for his six-year-old niece Carlotta after the disappearance of his sister. By his side are Pamela, an elderly transgender woman, and Jenny, a neighbor who is expecting a baby. When social services threaten to take the child away, Armony is forced to fight with all his strength to obtain legal guardianship.

1729933.title: NJPW Yuji Nagata Produce Blue Justice XIX ~Aogi Futotsu~
1729933.overview: Blue Justice XIX ~Aogi Futotsu~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on September 6, 2026 at Togane Arena in Togane, Chiba, Japan.

1733325.title: AMUCK
1733325.overview: A man who laments "not even feeling like the main character of his own story" suddenly finds himself aware of the camera that's watching him, eliciting a mind-bending journey of self discovery.

1735053.title: The Newcomers
1735053.overview: Three tweens investigate what is poisoning their village's rivers. Mateo narrates as he, his brother Tomas, refugee Tiana, and her dog Nube embark on an adventure to uncover the source of pollution.

1735309.title: Istimewa
1735309.overview: Five disabled children embark on a desperate search for their runaway foster father, only to find themselves thrust into the public eye.

1735693.title: Las damas
1735693.overview: Alba, an artist-in-residence at the Casa de Velázquez, struggles to find her place in the world and in her own body.

1736461.title: What Belongs to Others

1738637.title: Arrival
1738637.overview: After arriving in Aotearoa as refugees, a mother and daughter find their roles upended in the face of a new and unfamiliar world.

1739853.title: Мастер
1739853.overview: The documentary "Master" is dedicated to one of the most prominent figures in the history of Russian cinema—the brilliant film scholar, Chairman of the Russian State Cinematography Committee, professor at VGIK, and longtime president of the Window to Europe film festival—Armen Nikolaevich Medvedev. The film's central focus is the 1990s, a turning point for the country and a pivotal moment in Medvedev's career. Separate chapters are devoted to VGIK and the Vyborg Film Festival, the film's subject's beloved creative outlets. The film draws on the recollections of colleagues, friends, and students, who speak with sincere warmth and gratitude about the master's role in their lives and the life of Russian cinema.

1740877.title: Storm on Sesame Street
1740877.overview: As a big storm approaches, Elmo and friends work together to get ready. After it passes, Sesame Street looks different — and everyone pitches in to help.

1741645.title: Blessings
1741645.overview: Ray and Tyler go on a fishing trip. Ray has a proposal; hilarity ensues.

1744973.title: Carnival of the Animals
1744973.overview: A colourful town inhabited by animals prepares for a carnival parade.

1745037.title: Identity
1745037.overview: During the Bosnian War, hundreds of ethnic Bosniak women were sent to specially designed rape camps set up by the military forces of the Republic of Srpska. Many of them had chosen to abort, however, some gave birth to these children. Now, thirty years after the traumatic events that led to their conception have taken place, three of them choose to disclose the truth of their origin and fight against the stigma many of them face in everyday life.

1745101.title: Ё
1745101.overview: The place of the letter Ё in the Russian language intrigues a young writer named Roman, and he decides to dedicate his first book to it. Work progresses slowly, as Roman is hampered by work, household chores, and a lack of time in the day. One day, clones appear in his life, ready to take on all his chores and responsibilities, just so he can write. At first, everything goes well, but over time, the relationship between Roman and the clones frays, as everyone vie for the writer's place.

1745741.title: The Encounter
1745741.overview: After a young man comes into contact with something otherworldly, two investigators are sent to uncover what happened.

1746189.title: Another Day

A day before his departure, Albin slips out of home in search of the man he fought with. What begins as a search for closure takes an unexpected turn when he meets Marty, the stranger he was looking for, and as the day unfolds, anger slowly gives way to understanding, reconciliation and the healing of old wounds.

Finding himself in the midst of a dangerous chaos unlike anything he has ever known, Mahsun now faces two major challenges: getting rid of Mümin and getting his career—now jeopardized because of him—back on track.
